instruction: Add a disk to the Vagrant VM via Libvirt
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "libvirt" do |lv| lv.storage :file, size: "20G" end' >> Vagrantfile
echo 'config.vm.provider "libvirt" do |lv| lv.storage :file, size: "10G", type: "raw" lv.storage :file, size: "5G", type: "qcow2", device: "vdc" end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Attach an existing image as a disk in Libvirt
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "libvirt" do |lv| lv.storage :file, path: "/var/lib/libvirt/images/existing.qcow2", allow_existing: true end' >> Vagrantfile
echo 'config.vm.provider "libvirt" do |lv| lv.boot "hd" lv.boot "cdrom" end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Set a static MAC on a Libvirt private network
Enable KSM (Kernel Same-page Merging) in Libvirt
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "libvirt" do |lv| lv.memory_backing :access, mode: "shared" end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Set an autostart flag for a Vagrant VM
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "libvirt" do |lv| lv.autostart = true end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Configure default provider for a Vagrant environment

output: echo 'config.trigger.before :up do |trigger| trigger.info = "Starting VM..." trigger.run = {inline: "echo hello"} end' >> Vagrantfile
echo 'config.trigger.after :destroy do |trigger| trigger.info = "Cleanup complete" end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Use a trigger on a specific VM in multi-machine
output: echo 'config.trigger.before :destroy, machine: :db do |trigger| trigger.warn = "Destroying DB VM!" end' >> Vagrantfile
